info.title: Mobile Messaging Exchange - CDR Report API

tags: TOP 25 CDR by account Id & Time Frame
get.summary: message logs for a specific account Id & time frame

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: This is the customer account id assigned to the customer at the time of onboarding. User can specify one or more custAccountId.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: This is the from date in format of dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:SS (Ex. 03-03-2020 07:09:00) which customer account usage is available for usage report.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: This is the to date in in format of dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:SS (Ex. 03-03-2020 07:09:00) which customer account usage is available for usage report.

parameters.name: pageNo
parameters.description: Skip Number of records for paging

400.description: Request is semantically incorrect or missing required parameters. | Error: CDRs for the selected period are not loaded because the SMS retry period of 72 hours is not completed

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: This is the customer Message Id.

requestTime.description: This is the time when request is come to the MMX Hub.

lastDeliveredTime.description: This is the Last delivered time.

messageId.description: This is the internal unique Message Id.

submittedStatus.description: This is the status of submitted message.

deliveredStatus.description: This is the status of delivered message.
